cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 generic teaching before thanks and A3 near-my-way before weekend offer only loosely imply trained generosity; A5 flight cancellation drops teacher relation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 previous shift cover makes A3 whole weekend; B4 Sunday swapped for airport makes A5 canceled flight and holiday cover.

relationship.evidence: B4 has already made a useful arrangement that A new offer does not address.

heightening.evidence: A5 sacrifices its own trip to exceed the growing care received.

specificity.evidence: A1 lift and B2/B4 shifts make the ledger of favors clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 stock grade is less specific than the actual not-more-than-me motive.
